propositions.name: optical_medium_is_electromagnetic_field
propositions.statement: The elastic medium through which the vibrations of light are propagated is the same substance as the field in which electromagnetic phenomena take place.
propositions.quote: At the commencement of this paper we made use of the optical hypothesis of an elastic medium through which the vibrations of light are propagated, in order to show that we have warrantable grounds for seeking, in the same medium, the cause of other phenomena as well as those of light.

propositions.name: light_and_magnetism_same_substance
propositions.statement: Light and magnetism are affections of the same substance, and light is an electromagnetic disturbance propagated through the field according to electromagnetic laws.
propositions.quote: The agreement of the results seems to show that light and magnetism are affections of the same substance, and that light is an electromagnetic disturbance propagated through the field according to electromagnetic laws.

propositions.name: wave_has_definite_velocity
propositions.statement: A plane wave through the field has one definite velocity V that is the same in either direction of propagation.
propositions.quote: The other equations give the same value for V, so that the wave is propagated in either direction with a velocity V.

propositions.name: wave_has_definite_direction_at_any_point
propositions.statement: A propagated wave has a definite direction of propagation and a definite disturbance at any point, so that direction of propagation is a fact of the same kind everywhere in the field.
propositions.quote: Hence magnetic disturbances propagated through the electromagnetic field agree with light in this, that the disturbance at any point is transverse to the direction of propagation, and such waves may have all the properties of polarized light.

propositions.name: magnetization_in_plane_of_wave
propositions.statement: The direction of the magnetization in a propagated wave must be in the plane of the wave.
propositions.quote: which shows that the direction of the magnetization must be in the plane of the wave.

propositions.name: transverse_vibrations_only
propositions.statement: The equations of the electromagnetic field, deduced from experimental evidence, show that only transversal vibrations can be propagated.
propositions.quote: The equations of the electromagnetic field, deduced from purely experimental evidence, show that transversal vibrations only can be propagated.

propositions.name: electromagnetic_and_optical_agree_on_transversality
propositions.statement: Electromagnetic science and optical science both affirm the propagation of transverse vibrations through the field and give the same velocity of propagation.
propositions.quote: Hence electromagnetic science leads to exactly the same conclusions as optical science with respect to the direction of the disturbances which can be propagated through the field; both affirm the propagation of transverse vibrations, and both give the same velocity of propagation.

propositions.name: v_equals_velocity_of_light_in_vacuum
propositions.statement: The number of electrostatic units in one electromagnetic unit of electricity should be equal to the velocity of light in air or vacuum.
propositions.quote: is the number of electrostatic units in one electromagnetic unit of electricity, and this, according to our result, should be equal to the velocity of light in air or vacuum.

propositions.name: weber_kohlrausch_ratio_applies_to_vacuum
propositions.statement: The value of v obtained from the electromagnetic experiments of Weber and Kohlrausch is the same quantity as the velocity of light in air or vacuum, so that a ratio of units measured in one experiment gives a velocity applicable in vacuum.
propositions.quote: is the number of electrostatic units in one electromagnetic unit of electricity, and this, according to our result, should be equal to the velocity of light in air or vacuum.

propositions.name: aberration_yields_light_velocity_in_surrounding_space
propositions.statement: The velocity of light in the space surrounding the earth can be deduced from the coefficient of aberration and the received value of the radius of the earth's orbit.

propositions.name: earth_moves_through_field_of_light_propagation
propositions.statement: The earth moves in an orbit through the space in which light is propagated with velocity V, and this motion together with the orbit radius gives the coefficient of aberration.
propositions.quote: The velocity of light in the space surrounding the earth, deduced from the coefficient of aberration and the received value of the radius of the earth's orbit, is

propositions.name: one_velocity_of_light_across_experiments
propositions.statement: The velocity of light deduced from Fizeau's and Foucault's optical experiments and from aberration is a single quantity that agrees with the value of v from the electromagnetic experiments.

propositions.name: foucault_revolving_mirror_gives_velocity
propositions.statement: The velocity of light V can be obtained by determining the angle through which a revolving mirror turned while the reflected light went and returned along a measured course.
propositions.quote: The value of V found by M. Foucault was obtained by determining the angle through which a revolving mirror turned, while the light reflected from it went and returned along a measured course.

propositions.name: measured_course_and_round_trip_time_classical
propositions.statement: The measured course over which the light went and returned has a definite length, and the angle turned by the revolving mirror gives the time of that round trip, so that length divided by time yields the velocity of light.
propositions.quote: The value of V found by M. Foucault was obtained by determining the angle through which a revolving mirror turned, while the light reflected from it went and returned along a measured course.

propositions.name: electrical_v_and_optical_V_directly_combinable
propositions.statement: A value of v determined from purely electrical experiments (with no use of light except to see the instruments) and a value of V determined from purely optical experiments (with no use of electricity or magnetism) are values of the same physical velocity and can be equated.
propositions.quote: No use whatever was made of electricity or magnetism.

propositions.name: perfect_dielectric_has_no_true_conduction

propositions.name: no_motion_of_conductors_in_wave_setup
propositions.statement: In the wave-propagation setup there is no motion of conductors in the field, so that electromotive forces are due only to variations of the electromagnetic or the electrostatic functions.
propositions.quote: These electromotive forces are due to the variations either of the electromagnetic or the electrostatic functions, as there is no motion of conductors in the field

propositions.name: field_defines_state_relative_to_which_motion_is_definite
propositions.statement: The phrase 'no motion of conductors in the field' presupposes that the field defines a state with respect to which motion of a conductor is a definite fact.
propositions.quote: These electromotive forces are due to the variations either of the electromagnetic or the electrostatic functions, as there is no motion of conductors in the field

propositions.name: free_electricity_immoveable_in_perfect_insulator
propositions.statement: In a perfect insulator the free electricity is immoveable, so that J is either constant, zero, or uniformly increasing or diminishing with the time, and no disturbance depending on J can be propagated as a wave.
propositions.quote: , and the value of J is either constant or zero, or uniformly increasing or diminishing with the time; so that no disturbance depending on J can be propagated as a wave.

propositions.name: conductor_transforms_electrical_energy_to_heat
propositions.statement: If the medium is a conductor with resistance per unit volume ρ, true currents of conduction transform electrical energy into heat and thereby weaken the undulation.

propositions.name: insulators_transparent_conductors_opaque
propositions.statement: Most transparent solid bodies are good insulators, whereas all good conductors are very opaque.
propositions.quote: (107) Most transparent solid bodies are good insulators, whereas all good conductors are very opaque.

propositions.name: gold_transparency_requires_frequency_dependent_loss
propositions.statement: The observation that gold-leaf transmits some green light cannot be reconciled with the electromagnetic theory of light unless there is less loss of energy when electromotive forces are reversed with the rapidity of the vibrations of light than when they act for sensible times.
propositions.quote: This result cannot be reconciled with the electromagnetic theory of light, unless we suppose that there is less loss of energy when the electromotive forces are reversed with the rapidity of the vibrations of light than when they act for sensible times, as in our experiments.

propositions.name: crystal_axes_of_induction_align_with_electric_elasticity
propositions.statement: In a crystallized medium, the axes of magnetic induction are assumed to coincide in direction with those of electric elasticity, in order to make the propagation calculation tractable.
propositions.quote: Further experiments on the magnetic and dielectric properties of crystals are required before we can decide whether the relation of these bodies to magnetic and electric forces is the same, when these forces are permanent as when they are alternating with the rapidity of the vibrations of light.

propositions.name: principal_plane_polarized_ray_has_same_velocity_all_directions
propositions.statement: In each principal plane of a crystal, the ray polarized in that plane obeys the ordinary law of refraction, so that its velocity is the same in whatever direction in that plane it is propagated.
propositions.quote: Now we know that in each principal plane of a crystal the ray polarized in that plane obeys the ordinary law of refraction, and therefore its velocity is the same in whatever direction in that plane it is propagated.

propositions.name: half_energy_electric_half_magnetic
propositions.statement: In a propagated light wave, half of the energy per unit of volume consists of magnetic and half of electric energy.
propositions.quote: where P represents the greatest value of the electromotive force. Half of this consists of magnetic and half of electric energy.

propositions.name: forces_reversed_twice_per_vibration_of_light
propositions.statement: The electromotive and magnetic forces in light must be conceived to be reversed twice in every vibration of light, more than a thousand million million times in a second.
propositions.quote: These electromotive and magnetic forces must be conceived to be reversed twice in every vibration of light; that is, more than a thousand million million times in a second.

propositions.name: sunlight_mechanical_value_at_earth_is_definite
propositions.statement: The mechanical value of direct sunlight at the Earth has a definite value that can be used with the electromagnetic equations to compute the greatest value of the electromotive force P in sunlight.
